providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Public providers to collect. Lambda and TensorDock require their API keys as Actor environment variables.

maxItemsPerProvider.title: Maximum offers per provider
maxItemsPerProvider.description: Upper bound on normalized offers emitted per provider.

minGpuMemoryGb.title: Minimum VRAM (GB)
minGpuMemoryGb.description: Drop offers whose reported VRAM is below this value. Unknown VRAM is retained.

includeRawPayload.title: Include raw provider payload
includeRawPayload.description: Include the source record for provenance. Disable to reduce dataset size.
